ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm HermeticWiper EaseUS signed-driver abuse for raw-disk destruction
ucs.description: Hunts the load/drop of the legitimate EaseUS Partition Master kernel driver (empntdrv.sys / epmntdrv.sys) that Sandworm's HermeticWiper (FoxBlade) and related wipers abuse to gain raw physical-disk write access and corrupt the MBR/MFT. The driver is signed by CHENGDU YIWO Tech (EaseUS) and is benign on its own, so its presence on a host with no EaseUS partition software installed is a near-unique Sandworm wiper indicator rather than a generic destruction template.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Endpoint.Filesystem.file_name IN ("empntdrv.sys","epmntdrv.sys","emntdrv.sys") AND Endpoint.Filesystem.file_path="*\\drivers\\*" by Endpoint.Filesystem.dest Endpoint.Filesystem.file_name Endpoint.Filesystem.file_path Endpoint.Filesystem.process_name Endpoint.Filesystem.user 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Endpoint.Filesystem)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| join type=outer dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Services where Endpoint.Services.service_path IN ("*empntdrv*","*epmntdrv*") by Endpoint.Services.dest Endpoint.Services.service_name Endpoint.Services.service_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Endpoint.Services)`] 
| where file_name!="" 
| table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name file_name file_path service_name service_path count 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let EaseUsDrivers = dynamic(["empntdrv.sys","epmntdrv.sys","emntdrv.sys"]);
// Hosts that legitimately run EaseUS partition software — strip them to kill the only real FP source
let EaseUsHosts = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has "EaseUS" or FileName has_any ("epm.exe","PartitionMaster.exe")
    | distinct DeviceName;
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName has_any (EaseUsDrivers)
| where FolderPath has @"\drivers\"
| where DeviceName !in (EaseUsHosts)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"          // exclude pure machine-account noise; wiper often runs as a service though, keep for triage
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath !has @"\EaseUS"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, DriverName = FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let EaseUsDrivers = dynamic(["empntdrv.sys","epmntdrv.sys","emntdrv.sys"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventType == "FileCreated"
| where TargetFileName has_any (EaseUsDrivers)
| where TargetFilePath has @"\drivers\"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername
| order by TimeGenerated desc

date: 2026/05/27

  product: windows

      - '\epmntdrv.sys'

    TargetFilename|contains: '\drivers\'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate EaseUS Partition Master installation
level: high

ucs.title: [LLM] Seashell Blizzard (BadPilot) edge-service exploitation: web-server process spawns shell + recon
ucs.description: Hunts an internet-facing web/application service process (IIS w3wp, Tomcat/Java, Apache, ConnectWise ScreenConnect) spawning a command shell or built-in discovery LOLBin — the webshell-execution signature of Sandworm's BadPilot initial-access subgroup, which mass-exploits public-facing apps (Exchange/OWA, ConnectWise CVE-2024-1709, Fortinet, Zimbra) for opportunistic global access before handing off to destructive operators.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Endpoint.Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat*.exe","java.exe","nginx.exe","php-cgi.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","w3svc.exe") AND Endpoint.Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe") by Endpoint.Processes.dest Endpoint.Processes.user Endpoint.Processes.parent_process_name Endpoint.Processes.process_name Endpoint.Processes.process Endpoint.Processes.parent_process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Endpoint.Processes)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| where NOT user IN ("*$") 
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process parent_process count 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","java.exe","nginx.exe","php-cgi.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","w3svc.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildProc = FileName,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentLeaf = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ChildLeaf = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ParentLeaf in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","java.exe","nginx.exe","php-cgi.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","w3svc.exe")
| where ChildLeaf in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
